bonus_tip.title: 3-Minute Daily Face Glow Routine
bonus_tip.content:
🎁 *Bonus: 3-Minute Daily Face Glow & Lymphatic Tip* ✨

1️⃣ *Hydrate:* Hamesha clean face par 2 drops light oil ya moisturizer lagayein.
2️⃣ *Jawline Sculpt:* Index & middle finger se chin se ears ki taraf 10 upward strokes dein.
3️⃣ *Under-Eye Acupressure:* Ring finger se inner eye corners par gentle press karein for instant depuffing!

Live session mein trainer iski correct posture technique sikhayenge! 🌸

conversion_hooks: ⚡ Face Yoga activates 57 facial muscles — most people only use 12% of them daily. Our live classes teach you to 'wake up' the rest for a natural lift and sculpt.
⚡ A 20-week study by Northwestern University found women practicing daily facial exercises looked on average 3 years younger — no creams, no procedures.
⚡ Did you know? Lymphatic drainage (taught in our Face Yoga classes) reduces puffiness and under-eye circles — students notice a visible difference in just 2 weeks.
⚡ Unlike skincare products, Face Yoga results are structural — you're strengthening and toning the actual muscles under your skin, not just masking the surface.
⚡ Our students practice from home with zero equipment — just 20-30 minutes per class, 5 days a week, and the results are visible within the first month.
